scope: British Columbia certified airport priority records within the province and Masset Municipal Airport. This register records artwork findings alongside the separate provincial facility inventory.
method: Checked current official airport and operator sites, official publications and named corroborating sources. SVG structures were parsed for geometric artwork and embedded images. PDF marks were located on rendered pages and checked against drawing and image object geometry. PDF page references are one-based physical pages unless otherwise specified. Artwork remains at source.

statusDefinitions.verified-vector: At least one airport signature verified as native geometry in a source SVG or publication.
statusDefinitions.verified-raster: Airport signature verified from its airport or municipal publisher, with raster artwork presently identified.
statusDefinitions.documented-raster-lead: Airport signature documented in a specific publication, with current use or original artwork pending.
statusDefinitions.documented-vector-lead: Specific vector source lead identified, with geometry or direct access pending.
statusDefinitions.operator-brand-only: The checked official sources use an operator or government mark. A separate airport logo remains unverified.
statusDefinitions.no-separate-mark-found: Named facility checked, with no separate logo in the reviewed sources.
statusDefinitions.branding-in-development: The operator has publicly documented a branding project, with released artwork still to verify.
